entries.title: Job 20:1
segments: ¶Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

entries.title: Job 20:2
segments: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for [this] I make haste. {I make...: Heb. my haste is in me}

words.text: . {I make...: Heb. my haste is in me}

entries.title: Job 20:3
segments: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

entries.title: Job 20:4
segments: Knowest thou [not] this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

entries.title: Job 20:5
segments: That the triumphing of the wicked [is] short, and the joy of the hypocrite [but] for a moment? {short: Heb. from near}

entries.title: Job 20:6
segments: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds; {clouds: Heb. cloud}

entries.title: Job 20:7
segments: [Yet] he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where [is] he?

entries.title: Job 20:8
segments: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

words.text: : yea, he shall be chased away

entries.title: Job 20:9
segments: The eye also [which] saw him shall [see him] no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

entries.title: Job 20:10
segments: ¶His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods. {His children...: or, The poor shall oppress his children}

words.text: . {His children...: or, The poor shall oppress his children}

entries.title: Job 20:11
segments: His bones are full [of the sin] of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

entries.title: Job 20:12
segments: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, [though] he hide it under his tongue;

entries.title: Job 20:13
segments: [Though] he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth: {within...: Heb. in the midst of his palate}

words.text: it not; but keep it still
: {within...: Heb. in the midst of his palate}

entries.title: Job 20:14
segments: [Yet] his meat in his bowels is turned, [it is] the gall of asps within him.

entries.title: Job 20:15
segments: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

words.text: , and he shall vomit them up again

entries.title: Job 20:16
segments: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.

entries.title: Job 20:17
segments: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter. {the floods...: or, streaming brooks}

entries.title: Job 20:18
segments: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow [it] down: according to [his] substance [shall] the restitution [be], and he shall not rejoice [therein]. {his...: Heb. the substance of his exchange}

words.text: [therein]. {his...: Heb. the substance of his exchange}

entries.title: Job 20:19
segments: Because he hath oppressed [and] hath forsaken the poor; [because] he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not; {oppressed: Heb. crushed}

entries.title: Job 20:20
segments: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired. {feel: Heb. know}

entries.title: Job 20:21
segments: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods. {none...: or, be none left for his meat}

words.text: There shall none of his meat
. {none...: or, be none left for his meat}

entries.title: Job 20:22
segments: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him. {wicked: or, troublesome}

entries.title: Job 20:23
segments: ¶[When] he is about to fill his belly, [God] shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain [it] upon him while he is eating.

words.text: [it] upon him while he is eating

entries.title: Job 20:24
segments: He shall flee from the iron weapon, [and] the bow of steel shall strike him through.

entries.title: Job 20:25
segments: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors [are] upon him.

entries.title: Job 20:26
segments: All darkness [shall be] hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

entries.title: Job 20:27
segments: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

entries.title: Job 20:28
segments: The increase of his house shall depart, [and his goods] shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

entries.title: Job 20:29
segments: This [is] the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God. {appointed...: Heb. of his decree from God}

words.text: . {appointed...: Heb. of his decree from God}
